info.name: GoRestify
info.description:
Complete GoRestify Postman collection for Admin and User APIs.

## Quick start
1. Start admin API (`make admin`) on port 6969.
2. Run **Admin → Auth → Login** (auto-saves `token` / `refresh_token`).
3. Edit path/query params on each request (IDs are per-request, not collection vars).

## Bases
- Admin: `{{endpoint_go_restify_admin}}` → `/api/admin/v1`
- User: `{{endpoint_go_restify_user}}` → `/api/user/v1`

## Notes
- User app has **no login**; reuse Admin JWT.
- Accounts are split: **Users** (`type=user`, requires `role_id`) and **Customers** (`type=customer`).
- Do not send `type` in body — routes force it.
- List query: `page`, `page_size` (max 100), `order_by`, `direction`, `filter`.
- `POST /transactions` = DoTransaction (balanced slots required).
- Slots & Account Credits are **read-only** over HTTP.
